working_agreement: Requested 2026-11-13: create the spec and proceed as for tool-permissions. Implement the planned slices in order and fix in-scope review findings; commit each slice, push its branch, and open its pull request without asking again. The design's proposals are implemented as written and corrected in review. Ask before merging or publishing.

criteria.a1: Input submitted mid-turn reaches the model before its next request, in the order it was submitted
criteria.a2: Interrupting during a tool call leaves completed results in context and does not replay them; the next request has a result for every tool call
criteria.a3: Cancellation of a running bash command terminates its process group
criteria.a4: Every command survives a JSON round trip, and a headless test drives a full steered turn with commands alone
criteria.a5: In the terminal the operator can type while a turn runs; queued input is shown as pending until delivered and then appears in the transcript where the model received it
criteria.a6: Escape returns to the prompt without ending the session, and undelivered input is not lost
criteria.a7: The command contract and session controller read no keys, hold no module-level state, and pass a guarded-import test; two sessions in one process are isolated
criteria.a8: Each delivered guidance message and each interrupt appears in the trace with actor user

slices.note: Shell commands run in their own process group; abort, timeout, and output cap terminate the group with escalation.
Guidance source drained at iteration boundaries, continuation at the final answer, interrupt that resolves unresolved calls, trace records. Includes the per-adapter request-shape check.
Command types, AgentSession, approvals through commands, subpath export, example. CLI dispatches through it with the same keys as before.
Turn input reader, queued display, Escape restoring undelivered input, footer hint, README.
